dedupe_keys.name: collapse risk of nonductile reinforced concrete shear wall buildings

description: Collapse risk of nonductile reinforced concrete shear wall buildings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Carlos Molina Hutt, University of British Columbia (ubc.ca). Existing buildings, particularly those predating modern building codes, pose significant seismic risk in regions of high seismicity worldwide. In the City of Vancouver, British Columbia, reinforced concrete shear wall (RCSW) buildings are prevalent in tall building construction. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Non-ductile reinforced concrete,  Shear wall buildings,  Archetype development,  Collapse Risk. Published 2025-08-08. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
